interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the sections, Apply, Save and Reset.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through changing a colour and applying it.

interactive.label: color_data
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the data curve in decay plots. Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value such as #ffa52f.

interactive.label: color_model
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the fitted model curve. Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value.

interactive.label: color_irf
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the instrument response function (IRF). Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value.

interactive.label: color_residuals
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the weighted residuals panel. Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value.

interactive.label: color_auto_corr
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the autocorrelation curve. Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value.

interactive.label: color_region_selector
interactive.tooltip: Colour of the draggable fit-range band. Click the swatch for a colour picker, or type a hex value.

interactive.label: region_alpha
interactive.tooltip: Opacity of the fit-range band, 0 (invisible) to 255 (solid).

interactive.label: region_alpha.slider
interactive.tooltip: Opacity of the fit-range band, 0 (invisible) to 255 (solid).

interactive.label: active_transparency
interactive.tooltip: Opacity of the active plot, 0 to 1.

interactive.label: inactive_transparency
interactive.tooltip: Opacity of plots that are not active, 0 to 1.

interactive.label: Apply
interactive.tooltip: Write the edits into the active plot settings; plots created from now on use them, and open node graphs are re-styled.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Apply the edits and write them to settings_chisurf.yaml so they are kept for the next start.

interactive.label: Reset
interactive.tooltip: Reload every control from the active settings, discarding edits that were not applied.
